vetSays.line: 👥 A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek walks out with A person, maybe 50s, with sun-creased eyes. "Nobody walks alone today."
🚶 A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek is back with A person, maybe 50s, with sun-creased eyes.
A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.

🌱 A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek looks over the garden: turned soil, nothing planted. A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek sowed upright fuzzy red berry cones, compound leaves, velvety new branches in the empty plot — seed gathered during garden duty.
A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek came back with 510 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek: "a low bushy plant with paired oval leaves; nuts underground is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
📓 Journal: the man in his 50s taught the person in their 50s, with a scarred cheek Reading Tracks.
A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
🛡️ Dylan, Marvin, Dineo, Elijah and Jorge met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Dylan, Marvin, Dineo, Elijah, Jorge are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village.
